# Arrow IPC fixtures

`v1/` contains immutable binary fixtures used by the Rust, JavaScript, and
browser integration suites.

- `apache-arrow-1.0.0-generated-nested.arrow` is the official little-endian
  Arrow IPC file-format gold fixture produced by Apache Arrow's cross-language
  integration suite. It is vendored byte-for-byte at the commit recorded in
  `provenance.json`.
- `m4-sample.arrow` is the richer Playground fixture generated by the checked-in
  Rust generator. It includes 64-bit integers, decimals, nanosecond timestamps,
  nulls, dictionary values, nested values, and CJK text. Its digest is also
  locked by `provenance.json`.

The Apache fixture is licensed under Apache-2.0; the exact upstream license is
stored next to it. The Tabulark-generated fixture is dual-licensed with this
repository.
